messages:
priya: Heads-up — since ~09:13 UTC outbound requests from edge proxy pods in us-west-2 are failing to external S3 endpoints. App retries are timing out, lots of 504s from the sidecar.

lucas: Can you paste a log sample?

priya: envoy log snippet:
```
[2024-06-25T09:13:21.123Z] envoy egress: cluster 's3-us-west-2' no_route -> direct_response_code:503, body:'egress policy denied'
[2024-06-25T09:13:21.124Z] filter chain matched policy:egress-policy-v2 action:DENY host:s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com
```

chloe: That lines up with the rollout we did at ~08:50 — PR #2384 tightened sidecar egress rules and added a new filter that rejects unknown outbound hosts. I feared this would catch some dynamic hosts.

dan: Confirmed — I grepped the generated Envoy config on one of the broken pods. There's an `envoy.filters.http.egress_policy` entry with an allowlist. When the Host header doesn't match an entry it sets `upstream_cluster: blackhole` (=> 503).

deploy-bot: Rollout of pr-2384 to cluster eng-infra/edge completed at 2024-06-25T08:52:12Z by lucas.

priya: Oof. S3 hostnames are sometimes rewritten by our client libs (virtual-host vs path-style), so some variants weren't covered. Need quick fix — either rollback pr-2384 or add s3 host patterns to allowlist.

marc: Which is faster? Rollback the whole PR or hotpatch allowlist?

lucas: Hotpatch allowlist is lower blast radius. I'll open a tiny PR to add `*.amazonaws.com` and explicit `s3-*` patterns.

chloe: Also propose adding an egress-gateway rule so edge pods route external stable services via an egress gateway with broader TLS passthrough — reduces need for huge host allowlists in every sidecar. Opened issue #412 for that.

dan: I've prepared canary patch pr-2389 with `allow: ["*.amazonaws.com", "s3-*.amazonaws.com"]`. Rolling to canary pool now.

priya: Canary applied to 10% of edge nodes ~09:24. S3 success rate jumped to 99.8% for that pool. No regressions observed.

marc: Good. Once canary stabilizes, roll to remaining nodes. Also add a unit/integration test so that any egress-policy change runs a hostname pattern test against a curated list (S3, big partner endpoints, common CDNs).

lucas: Rollout started at 09:33, target complete in ~15m. I'll monitor metrics.

deploy-bot: pr-2389 rolled out to eng-infra/edge (full) at 2024-06-25T09:45:05Z.

priya: After full rollout traffic is healthy again. Thanks y'all.

chloe: Follow-ups: (1) postmortem that includes why host variants weren't covered, (2) add e2e tests for egress list, (3) backlog item for egress-gateway. I'll own the postmortem.

dan: Also added an alert: `egress_cluster_error_rate > 1%` for >5m on edge pools.

priya: :thumbsup: Closing incident, will link postmortem when ready.
